run_lm_eval_harness: run the lm-eval harness evaluation on a model using EvalHarnessLM with specified tasks and generation config
run_generate_until: run generate_until on EvalHarnessLM to produce text generations from prompts with stop words and metrics tracking
run_loglikelihood_rolling: run loglikelihood_rolling on EvalHarnessLM to compute rolling log-likelihood scores for long documents
run_loglikelihood_tokens: run _loglikelihood_tokens on EvalHarnessLM to compute log-likelihood of context-continuation token pairs with batching
run_eval_main: run the main evaluation function with Arguments, EvalArguments, and GenerationConfig for autoregressive or self-speculative generation
